facts.text: The Audacity is set in Palo Alto and follows tech CEO Duncan Park (Billy Magnussen), inspired by real Silicon Valley archetypes like Elon Musk and Mark Zuckerberg. Creator Jonathan Glatzer said he was specifically drawn to the tier just below the very top of tech power — "the wannabes, the also-rans" who want the tippy top but can't quite reach it.

The show's premise — a CEO blackmailing his own therapist — is personal for Glatzer: he grew up with a therapist mother and a psychiatrist stepfather who both kept offices in the family home, with clients from their small New Jersey town frequently around.
AMC renewed the show for a second season in March 2026 — before it had even premiered on April 12, 2026, an unusually early vote of confidence for a new series.

The 8-episode first season premiered on AMC/AMC+ in April 2026, then made its Netflix US streaming debut months later on August 19, 2026 — a two-stage release AMC has used for several of its recent prestige shows.
Real critical reception is mixed-to-positive: 70% on Rotten Tomatoes and 63 on Metacritic. Reviewers were lukewarm on the show as a whole but specifically praised Billy Magnussen's lead performance.
